title: Inside the fossil egg
hook: Some fossils capture an early stage of life.

doesNotKnow: Recognize an embryo as evidence of development before hatching.

misconception: All dinosaur fossils show only fully grown animals.
objective: Recognize an embryo as evidence of development before hatching.

claims.text: Some fossils capture an early stage of life. An identified fossil embryo lies inside an egg. What developmental stage can it reveal? The schematic shows an embryo inside an identified egg. Such a fossil can give evidence about development before hatching; it does not by itself record the animal’s whole life or prove parental care.

claims.text: The figure is a simplified, not-to-scale schematic of a stated example, not an image of an identified specimen.
Recall: A fossil embryo is found inside an identified egg. What stage does it represent? An embryo in an egg represents development before hatching.
